title: Complete portable install manifest
summary: Provide a pinned file manifest that distinguishes starter files, optional tooling, and protected adopter data. Include the upstream notice in the complete supported copy.
acceptance_criteria: A clean install can verify the expected path and file identity for every selected file.
Manually retained and adopter-owned files are accounted for when comparing the plan to the full starter.

evidence.claim: The existing planner's allowlist does not enumerate the package README or LICENSE.
